claims.text: S1Q3T3 (S wave in lead I, Q wave and inverted T wave in lead III) or a new right bundle branch block may reflect sudden right ventricular enlargement; moderately specific but seen in only about 5% of patients.
claims.quote: An S1Q3T3 (S wave in lead I, Q wave in lead III, inverted T wave in lead III) or a new right bundle branch block may indicate the effect of abrupt rise in RV size affecting RV conduction pathways; these findings are moderately specific but insensitive, occurring in only about 5% of patients

claims.text: Other findings: right axis deviation (R > S in V1), P-pulmonale, and T-wave inversion in V1 to V4.
claims.quote: Right axis deviation (R > S in V1) and P-pulmonale may be present. T-wave inversion in leads V1 to V4 also occurs.

notes.issue: 'reflects' stated as certain what the source hedges.
notes.resolution: Revised to 'may reflect sudden right ventricular enlargement'; re-checked OK by shay-49353 at 2026-10-05T02:21Z.
